atelier — one owner per item, observed evidence, the project owner decides.

Sessions   unwrap [--project P] · wrap "summary" [--next TEXT] [--found TEXT]... [--push] [--no-check | --allow-failing] [--project P]
Setup      login --server URL · login --store · init [--title TEXT] [--check CMD]... [--declare-read-only TEXT] [--protect GLOB]... [--sandbox-only] [--refuse-overlap] [--approval TEXT] [--regenerate CMD] [--reset] [--history-since YYYY-MM-DD] · sync · publish
           notes-remote [REMOTE | --off]
Items      new "title" [--scope GLOB]... [--non-goal TEXT]... [--stop-when TEXT]... [--next-gate TEXT] · edit ID [--non-goal TEXT]... [--stop-when TEXT]... [--next-gate TEXT]
           ls [--all] [--json] · show ID [--json] · owners [--json] · inbox [--json] · status [--project P] [--json] (with a project: where it stands, as text) · open
Agents     start ID [--as H/M] [--runner home:NAME] · done "summary" [--sandbox]
           claim ID --as H/M [--runner home:NAME] · finish [--sandbox] [--summary T] · push [--force] · update · check [--sandbox] [--merged] [-- CMD] · report [ID] "what you verified and how" [--item ID] [--project P] · submit [--summary T]
           handoff ID --to H/M [--note TEXT] · release ID [--note TEXT] · block [ID] "what it is waiting on" · unblock [ID] · diff ID · review ID --approve|--reject [--note TEXT] [--head SHA] [--findings JSON] · review-claim ID [--runner home:NAME] · review-release ID [--note T]
           read-token ID · base-token ID · integrated ID --part KEY --merge-commit SHA · integration-failed ID --part KEY --reason TEXT
Owner      accept ID [--head SHA] [--override-review REASON] · merge ID [--head SHA [--approve [--note TEXT]] [--override-review REASON]] [--policy-changed-ok] · merge ID --cancel [--discard-local] · land ID [--reviewer H/M] [--no-review] [--dry-run] · abandon ID [--note TEXT] · defect ID --note TEXT [--found-in ID]
           served MODEL --recorded H/M --from TIME --to TIME [--item ID]... [--note T] [--apply] · approve ACTION --head SHA [--note T] [--expires 24h] · approvals [--all] · approvals withdraw ID [--note T]
           ship [--dry-run] [--push]
Plans      plan "goal" [--scope GLOB]... [--planner H/M] · plan show ID [--json]
           plan approve ID --hash HASH [--allow-paid] · plan revise ID --note TEXT
           plan reroute ID --to H/M · plan retry ID · plan stop ID [--note TEXT]
           plan post ID FILE
Models     models · models add ID --harness H --where home|cloud [--provider P] [--endpoint URL] [--keychain NAME] [--alias A]... [--note TEXT] · models remove ID
           dispatch ID [--to home|cloud|any] [--agent A] [--model M] [--note T] · undispatch ID · queue
Projects   projects rename OLD NEW · projects remove NAME [--force] · init --name NAME --rename-local
           adopt --project NAME [--as H/M]   (a ControlPlane project moves to Atelier)
Local      gc [--project NAME] [--dry-run | --apply] · runner --name home:NAME [--once] [--config PATH] [--integrate]
           runner --discover [--name home:NAME] [--probe] [--dry-run] [--config PATH]   (what each home model's harness serves)
           runner --usage [--name home:NAME] [--dry-run] [--config PATH]   (each tool's windows, served models, costs and balances)
Ops        ops COMMAND [ARGS...]   (portfolio operations, run by the private atelier-ops toolkit when installed)
Docs       guide   (paste into a project's AGENTS.md)

Tokens     token issue --as H/M [--project P]... [--days N] [--label TEXT] · token ls · token revoke ID
Common flags: --project NAME, --as harness/model (or ATELIER_ACTOR). A switch such as --approve, --json or --sandbox-only is on when named alone. It takes the word true or false after it and never any other word: --sandbox-only false or --sandbox-only=false turns it off.
